create_interactive_controller: create an InteractiveController instance with a ControllerConfig, Scene, and WindowView to manage interactive rendering
run_interactive_controller: run the InteractiveController game loop that handles user input, updates scene transforms, and renders frames
handle_keyboard_input: handle keyboard input via _on_key to move camera with WASD keys and toggle pause with spacebar
tick_scene_time: tick the scene time forward or backward by a delta using _tick with a specified timestep value
review_interactive_controller_class: review the InteractiveController class and its keyboard-driven camera controls and pause functionality
